_doc: Platinum's Town Map descriptions where its words differ from Pearl's (b2tools/platinum_text.py from the user's Platinum dump, bank 556's slot, through gen4_text): they replace those lines of data/text_overrides/town_map.json in a Platinum build only (patches/sinnoh_names.py text_overrides). Regenerate: PEARL_VERSION=platinum python3 b2tools/platinum_text.py

town_map.TownMap_Text_Pearl018: A canyon covered in untamed nature.\nIt is always shrouded by a dense fog.
town_map.TownMap_Text_Pearl024: Beyond the wall, one can see the\nstately Pokémon Mansion and the\nowner’s prized garden behind it.
town_map.TownMap_Text_Pearl063: A town where hot-blooded Trainers\ngather to work out and hone their\nbattling skills.
town_map.TownMap_Text_Pearl064: A town that attracts Trainers who\nknow there are other ways of enjoying\nPokémon than battling.
town_map.TownMap_Text_Pearl076: Huge deposits of coal still sleep\nunderneath the ground. The entrance\nto the Oreburgh Mine is here.
town_map.TownMap_Text_Pearl102: A tiny port city where Trainers who\nlove battling more than eating gather.
town_map.TownMap_Text_Pearl129: The Battle Frontier--where the best of\nthe best Trainers gather to test\ntheir skill--is located here.
